# Compixy

> Compixy is a free, browser-based tool for resizing, compressing, and converting images between PNG, JPG, and WebP formats. All processing happens locally in the user's browser — no files are ever uploaded to a server, making it a private option for handling personal or sensitive images.

## What it does
- Resize images to custom dimensions or one-click presets (512x512, 256x256, 128x128 app icon sizes; 1920x1080 HD)
- Convert between PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP formats
- Compress images with an adjustable quality slider (10-100%)
- Preserve aspect ratio automatically to prevent image distortion
- Respect EXIF orientation metadata from phone cameras

## Who it's for
- App and web developers needing app icon sizes (512x512, 256x256, 128x128)
- E-commerce sellers resizing product photos
- Website owners compressing images for faster page load
- Anyone needing to convert PNG screenshots to smaller WebP files, or shrink photos for WhatsApp/email

## Key facts
- 100% free, no signup or account required
- No watermarks added to output images
- No server upload — all image processing happens client-side via the browser's Canvas API
- Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP input and output formats
